meta_title: Ally — Always by your side | Vertex Corporation
meta_description: Ally is a proactive health companion from Vertex Corporation: AI-powered health tracking, the experimental Ally Ring, and open development. Always by your side.
og_description: Proactive health tracking from Vertex Corporation. In open alpha for iOS and Android.
hero_sub: More than just an app — a companion built to protect you everywhere, anytime. Software and hardware, one proactive health ecosystem.
builtwith_label: Our infrastructure and technologies are powered by the best
mission_title: Millions of preventable deaths occur every year. We refuse to accept this.
mission_lead: Ally's mission is simple, yet massive:
mission_body: to democratize health data, enable early diagnosis, and significantly reduce global mortality rates.
mission_p2: We combine software with hardware to build a shield around humanity — starting with an app that makes health tracking feel not like a chore, but like having someone by your side.
ring_lead: We are merging software with hardware. The Ally Ring is designed to be silent, powerful, and invisible. Continuous life tracking wrapped in superior aesthetics.
projects_sub: Our AI, gaming, and health tech products developed alongside Vertex.
project1_desc: Scalable AI architecture for high-performance data processing and machine learning models.
project2_desc: Our mobile game that redefines the classic card game experience with a modern twist.
project3_desc: Your smart AI core. Delivers unparalleled performance with real-time tracking and a zero-data policy.
roadmap_sub: Ally is designed to be more than just an app — a lifestyle companion. Here is what our team is building next.
road1_desc: Hit your goals, collect trophies, and climb the leaderboard — taking care of yourself is now fun.
road2_desc: Like annual music recaps, but for your health — monthly insights with simple and visual graphics.
road3_desc: Beyond standard smartwatches: native integrations for the Ally Ring and future accessories.
road4_desc: In an emergency or unusual inactivity, Ally automatically alerts the people you trust.
cta_sub: We are currently building in the open, in the alpha phase. Let's shape what Ally will become together.
footer_tagline: Always by your side. A health ecosystem developed by Vertex Corporation.
